pagePolicy.rule: The final compiled total may fall below 360, but not below 250, when authentic non-duplicative content does not justify 360 pages. Any revised total requires a continuous repaginated register and review; content must never be padded to hit a target.
prohibited: repeated boilerplate used to create pages
duplicate narrative presented as new evidence
oversized headings or whitespace used for artificial page inflation
invented appendices with no evidential or procedural purpose

densityLegend.prose_light: approximately 150–300 substantive words on a prose page, allowing authentic forms/signatures/spacing
densityLegend.prose_standard: approximately 300–550 substantive words on a prose page
densityLegend.prose_dense: approximately 500–750 substantive words where authentic for reports/transcripts
densityLegend.table_light: approximately 5–12 meaningful rows per table page
densityLegend.table_standard: approximately 10–25 meaningful rows per table page
densityLegend.table_dense: approximately 20–45 meaningful rows per schedule/log page where legible
densityLegend.image_light: one principal image/diagram or 2–4 smaller images with caption/source/scale where relevant
densityLegend.mixed: purpose-led combination of prose, tables and images without crowding

documents.contentPurpose: Navigate document boundaries, versions and compiled pages; expose missing/replaced items.
documents.qualityNotes: No evidential narrative or service inference.

documents.contentPurpose: Present visibly non-operative proposed counts and defendant allocation for qualified review.
documents.approximateDensity: 1–3 proposed counts plus status banner/version metadata; use only pages genuinely needed
documents.qualityNotes: Six working pages are a ceiling, not a reason to pad; charge status repeated only where needed for safety.

documents.contentPurpose: Summarise prosecution allegation, chronology, issues and evidential overview without replacing sources.
documents.qualityNotes: No repeated source-document prose copied wholesale.

documents.contentPurpose: Record unused/sensitive material descriptions, decisions, service and review states.
documents.approximateDensity: 18–40 meaningful schedule rows/page plus decision notes
documents.qualityNotes: Rows must be distinct and purpose-bearing; no cloned entries.

documents.contentPurpose: Record scene actions, exhibit recovery, packaging, seals, transfers and image references.
documents.approximateDensity: 15–35 log rows/page; 1–4 relevant images on image pages
documents.qualityNotes: Every image/log row needs distinct evidential purpose and provenance.

documents.contentPurpose: Preserve native event log and faithful call transcript with speaker/time uncertainty.
documents.qualityNotes: No transcript padding; pauses/inaudible markers only where source design requires.

documents.contentPurpose: Preserve the material draft account and version differences.
documents.qualityNotes: Draft status prominent; no boilerplate beyond realistic statement fields.

documents.contentPurpose: Present the signed account and enable line-level comparison to the draft.
documents.qualityNotes: Do not repeat irrelevant background solely to lengthen the statement.

documents.contentPurpose: Present D2-relevant observation with visibility and recollection limits.
documents.qualityNotes: Sketch only if it clarifies line of sight.

documents.contentPurpose: Provide distinct venue, first-response and background accounts.
documents.qualityNotes: No duplicated shared narrative; each witness must add distinct evidence or a material contradiction.

documents.contentPurpose: Record D1 custody events, interview metadata and complete question/answer account.
documents.qualityNotes: Separate custody record from transcript; no repeated caution boilerplate beyond authentic events.

documents.contentPurpose: Record D2 custody events, interview and clarification note.
documents.qualityNotes: D2-specific; co-defendant allegations labelled and not converted into admissions.

documents.contentPurpose: Map clips/stills, continuity, timing offset, occlusion and metadata limitations.
documents.qualityNotes: No near-duplicate stills; full context around selected stills documented.

documents.contentPurpose: Separate handset/account/user/authorship and present relevant location/message material.
documents.qualityNotes: No screenshot repetition; derived schedules trace to native-like source identifiers.

documents.contentPurpose: Provide proportionate fictional primary clinical observations, imaging reports and treatment events.
documents.approximateDensity: authentic form density, typically 8–25 entries or 250–500 words/page
documents.qualityNotes: Minimise irrelevant medical detail; no invented full notes merely to add pages.

documents.contentPurpose: Reconcile source timestamps without silently resolving discrepancies.
documents.qualityNotes: Every row cites a primary source; no narrative duplication.

documents.contentPurpose: Record examination, injuries, samples, medical cause/mechanism opinion and limitations.
documents.approximateDensity: 350–650 words on report pages; 1–3 necessary diagrams/images on visual pages
documents.qualityNotes: Sensitive visuals use only purpose-led fictional diagrams; no decorative or repeated images.

documents.contentPurpose: Address neuropathological timing/mechanism questions and limits.
documents.qualityNotes: Only new/specialist analysis; do not repeat the full post-mortem report.

documents.contentPurpose: Report samples, methods, analytical findings, uncertainty and quality status.
documents.qualityNotes: Analytical results separated from behavioural or causal interpretation.

documents.contentPurpose: Provide limited interpretation of alcohol/medication findings and treatment context.
documents.qualityNotes: Do not repeat analytical tables unless required to explain an opinion change.

documents.contentPurpose: Record item examination, continuity, biology result and transfer/use limitations.
documents.approximateDensity: 300–550 words or 10–20 result rows/page; up to 2 necessary images/page
documents.qualityNotes: No categorical weapon-use wording or decorative close-ups.

documents.contentPurpose: State the defence expert's individual pathology position, materials and limitations.
documents.qualityNotes: Address disagreement without reproducing prosecution report wholesale; privilege/service state visible.

documents.contentPurpose: Authoritatively record expert agreements/disagreements at its date and unresolved questions.
documents.approximateDensity: 8–20 substantive issue rows/page with concise reasons
documents.qualityNotes: No party submissions, verdict language or artificial issue fragmentation.

documents.contentPurpose: Record sending, PTPH listing and operative directions/application/ruling states.
documents.approximateDensity: authentic court-form density, 8–25 fields/directions per page
documents.qualityNotes: Orders/notices separated from drafts and party proposals.

documents.contentPurpose: Show exact admission/agreed-fact text, owner, scope, version and procedural state.
documents.qualityNotes: Four pages are a maximum working allocation; no repeated propositions to fill space.

required: duplication scan across and within documents, including near-duplicate paragraphs, table rows and images
density review against each document's purpose and expected density, with justified exceptions
full-page visual QA of every generated page at readable scale, including clipping, overflow, blank/near-blank pages, tables, captions, headers, footers and pagination
professional readability review without artificial whitespace or cramped text
